title: Wasp
cannotDealEmptyColExists: Fill every empty column before dealing

frontendHint.moveToTableau: A card can be moved between tableau columns
frontendHint.dealStock: You can deal from the stock

tutorial.tableau: Seven columns are dealt here. Click or drag any face-up card (with everything on top of it) to move it. Wasp's signature rule: an empty column accepts any card (or pile) you like. Unlike Scorpion, this is the key to clearing the game.
tutorial.stock: Stock has 3 cards. Use the Deal button to add one card to each of columns 0-2. Empty columns block deal.
tutorial.controls: Action buttons: hint, give up, undo.

autoCompleteStockNotEmpty: Use up the stock to auto-complete
autoCompleteFaceDown: Turn all face-down cards face up to auto-complete
autoCompleteStockAndFaceDown: Use up the stock and turn all face-down cards face up to auto-complete
